  • Visite du fort de Sarah-Bernard

3.2 What to Pack

Make sure you’re fully equipped to enjoy the retreat to the fullest:

  • Swimwear – for the heated pool or a spontaneous beach swim
  • Comfortable walking/biking shoes – for hikes and rides along the coastal trails
  • Sunscreen & hat or cap – to protect yourself from the island sun
  • Light jacket or windbreaker – for breezy evenings or ferry crossings
  • Warm layers – even summer nights can get cool

3.4 The Hotel: Au grand large

Au grand large

Nestled on the wild coast of Belle-Île-en-Mer, Le Grand Large is a charming 3-star hotel perched above the ocean in the peaceful Goulphar Bay. Housed in a historic manor, the hotel blends authenticity and elegance, offering an intimate setting ideal for rest, reflection, and sunset gazing.

From the panoramic heated pool to the warm (Don’t forget your swimsuit), light-filled rooms overlooking the Atlantic or the moorlands, every detail is designed for comfort and serenity. The hotel also features a gourmet restaurant, family-friendly suites, and direct access to the island’s most scenic hiking and biking trails.

Located just 500 meters from the renowned Castel Clara thalassotherapy center, Le Grand Large is the perfect base for combining work, wellness, and discovery during your stay on the island.
